text.p: Results of elimination round second leg matches in the men's EuroLeague on Tuesday:
Bologna won first leg 73-70 and go through to the quarter-finals
In Tel Aviv: Maccabi Tel Aviv (Israel) 78 Efes Pilsen (Turkey) 65 (33-30)
Efes Pilsen won the first leg 76-67 and the teams will now meet in the deciding leg in Istanbul on Thursday.
Cibona won the first leg 61-58 and the teams will now meet in the deciding leg in Zagreb on Thursday.
Villeurbanne won the first leg 97-74 and the team will now meet in the deciding leg in Villeurbanne on Thursday.
Panathinaikos won the first leg 68-67 and go through to the quarter-finals
Barcelona won the first leg 95-77 and go through to the quarter-finals.
Olympiakos won the first leg 81-71 and the teams now meet in the deciding leg in Belgrade on Thursday.
In Bologna: Kinder Bologna (Italy) 83 Stefanel Milano 76 (44-40)
Kinder: Alessandro Abbio 20, Arijan Komazec 13, Zoran Savic 12.
Stefanel: Warren Kidd 25, Anthony Bowie 15, Gregor Fucka 12, Alessandro De Pol 12.
Stefanel won the first leg 67-59 and teams now meet in deciding leg in Milan on Thursday.
